name: What's the difference between keyword stuffing and effective topic cluster optimization for AI SEO?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between keyword stuffing and effective topic cluster optimization for AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keyword stuffing involves unnaturally repeating keywords in content, which harms readability and can result in search engine penalties. Effective topic cluster optimization, however, focuses on creating high-quality, comprehensive content that genuinely addresses a user's intent across a broad topic. It uses relevant keywords naturally within a well-structured internal linking system, guiding both users and search engines to related information. AI SEO algorithms prioritize contextual relevance and user experience, making keyword stuffing detrimental and thoughtful topic clustering highly beneficial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keyword stuffing is unnatural repetition, harming SEO. Effective topic cluster optimization creates comprehensive, high-quality content with natural keyword use and structured internal linking, valued by AI SEO.
